line_items.reasoning: Full-year adjusted revenues grew 7% (strongest in over a decade) with record Banking and Markets revenues, clearly exceeding the raised $84B+ full-year floor guidance and the ~5.5% NII ex-markets growth target.

The full-year efficiency ratio came in slightly below 64% as guided (consistent with reaffirmed guidance), though the 2026 target was softened from 'below 60%' to 'around 60%', which does not affect the Q4 reported result vs. prior guidance.

Reported EPS of $1.19 was materially depressed by the Russia held-for-sale accounting charge; even on an adjusted basis ($1.81), elevated Q4 expenses (Markets expenses up 14%) reinforced the guided pressure on near-term EPS, landing at the weaker end of expectations.
Markets Q4 revenues were only down 1% YoY (essentially flat sequentially relative to a record Q3), far better than the guided sequential decline exceeding the historical 15%-20% range.

Credit costs (NCL rates at or below the low end of guided ranges), share repurchases ($4.5B in Q4, $13B+ for the year under the $20B program), and CET1 (13.2% vs. ~12.8% target) all came in at or better than reaffirmed guidance.
